outcome.text: 53-9-3 in official play; ranked 5 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 77.86, Archimedes).

demand.text: Picking up both pieces was very important from the start, sideways cones above all, because the team expected many to be knocked over. It also wanted to reach between the hybrid nodes and rescore pieces from the bottom row.

auto.text: The team's path planner draws clothoid paths with heading waypoints, and the robot follows them with encoders and the IMU. The dashboard shows pitch and roll so auto engage can be checked before a match.

cycle.text: The human player drops pieces at the single substation with the cone tip toward the robot; the driver takes them off the ground and backs out. One button sets an intake position, the cascade has presets, and the robot remembers the last piece, so there are no separate outtake buttons.

gave_up.text: A full-width intake: fitting between the hybrid nodes limits width to about 18 in. The robot picks up only from the ground.

changed.text: Belts could not handle the intake's weight in some orientations, so the arm gearing ends in chain. The team moved to MAXSpline tubing, which transfers torque better and lasts the season. The dashboard was restarted many times.

solves.text: Collect sideways cones and cubes, and rescore pieces from the bottom row
